description: Attaches an employer to an SMI subject.

endMonth.description: When the subject left this job, if they have. A month number from 1 (January) to 12 (December).

endYear.description: When the subject left this job, if they have. A four-digit year, e.g. 2019.

isCurrent.description: Whether this is the subject's current employer, as opposed to a former one. Ask the user directly if it isn't clear from context.

position.description: The subject's job title or role at this employer.

startMonth.description: When the subject started this job. A month number from 1 (January) to 12 (December).

startYear.description: When the subject started this job. A four-digit year, e.g. 2019.

subjectId.description: The subject's id, from a prior smi_get_subject or subject-enrichment call.

name: smi_add_subject_employer
title: Add Subject Employer
